sagemath.command: set_random_seed(20261113); n=64; q=QQ(87)/100; p=[1 if random()<0.1 else 0 for k in range(n)]; N=matrix(QQ,n,n,lambda i,j: (1-p[j])*q if i==j+1 else 0); I=identity_matrix(QQ,n); P=prod([I+N^(2^j) for j in range(6)]); print('resets', sum(p)); print('product_times_I_minus_N_is_identity', P*(I-N)==I); print('N_nilpotent', N^n==0); print('inverse_equals_product', (I-N).inverse()==P); b=vector(QQ,[QQ(75)/2]+[p[k-1]*QQ(75)/2 for k in range(1,n)]); u=[b[0]]; [u.append(b[k] if p[k-1] else q*u[k-1]) for k in range(1,n)]; print('recurrence_equals_product', vector(QQ,u)==P*b)
sagemath.meaning: exact arithmetic over the rationals, 64 years, 6 factors: the product of (I + N^(2^j)) is the inverse of I - N and reproduces the recurrence with resets
